subject: Reminder: USSF NSIC - COSMOS AAS - MRAS
description: The U.S. Space Force's National Space Intelligence Center (NSIC) has a requirement for a vendor to furnish SMEs with deep domain knowledge of space intelligence, S&TI (Scientific and Technical Intelligence), and related disciplines to augment NSIC's organic teams.
